sections.title: Natural Conversational Connectors
sections.content: Authentic spoken Hungarian relies on pragmatic particles to manage shared knowledge and emphasis: *hiszen* (after all, you know: a reason the listener should accept), *persze* (of course, which you know from A1), *márpedig* (and yet / but the fact is), and *ugyancsak* (likewise, also).

items.spanish: Ne add fel, hiszen már nagyon jól beszélsz!
items.english: Don't give up; after all, you already speak very well!
This is, of course, in the interest of all of us.

items.spanish: Márpedig a szabályokat mindenkinek be kell tartania.
items.english: And yet, rules must be obeyed by everyone.
